public_rationale: Read plainly, the forecast says no part of CoreWeave's ~1.3 GW of contracted capacity would come online by the end of 2025 or during 2026. CoreWeave had about 360 MW active at the end of 2024 (e1). About 500 MW of the contracted total was Core Scientific capacity signed by October 2024 (e2). By March 2, 2026, Core Scientific said it had energized about 350 MW under the CoreWeave contract, out of about 590 MW in total (e3). So at least about 260 MW of capacity contracted by the end of 2024 came online well before the end of 2026. CoreWeave's own active power rose to more than 850 MW by December 31, 2025 (e4). If "done" meant the whole 1.3 GW, the forecast would not be due until the end of 2026, but the words "any of this project" point to any part.
limitations: The link between CoreWeave's active power and the end-2024 contracts is inferred from contract dates, not reported directly.
Under a 'whole project finished' reading the forecast would not be due until December 31, 2026.

our_interpretation: 'This project' is CoreWeave's roughly 1.3 GW of contracted power reported in its S-1 as of December 31, 2024.
Plain reading of 'any of this project is done': no part of the not-yet-active contracted capacity comes online (is energized or active) before the end of 2026.
A part counts as done when CoreWeave or its data center provider reports it energized or active.
criteria.support_condition: No part of the capacity CoreWeave had contracted at the end of 2024 beyond its then-active ~360 MW is reported energized or active by December 31, 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Any part of the capacity contracted by the end of 2024 that was not yet active is reported energized or active before December 31, 2026.
